optimizedContext.value:
# Initialize Persisted Spec State
## Rules
- Async `InitializePersistedSpecState.execute(input)`; `target: { kind: `spec`, specId } | { kind: `all`, workspaces? }`; optional `schemaRef`. Resolve explicit or effective project schema; one schema per call; differing subsets need separate calls.
- Per target: resolve schema once in Core composition; discover raw identity without metadata materialization; read aggregate snapshot; any existing state → `SpecAlreadyInitializedError`; load/parse schema canonical `scope: spec` artifacts; `resolveInitialPersistedDependsOn()`; `applyPersistedSpecStatePatch()` with `{ kind: `initial`, schema, dependsOn }` and empty patch; conditional full write `expectedRevision: null`.
- `dependsOn`: caller complete value (deps set/clear or archive plan), else deterministic canonical-artifact projection selected schema, else `[]`. Reuse `GenerateSpecMetadata` deterministic projection; never cache/snapshot metadata. Never import dependency/optimization/implementation cache values; initialize `implementation: []`, omit `optimizations`.
- Write sidecar only; never eagerly persist metadata; consumer self-heals cache. One-time: no `--force`, reassignment, reinitialization; existing single target throws.
- Batch `all`: preselect lock-less (optional workspace filter), exclude initialized; process all eligible despite failures; return `initialized`, per-spec `failed`, `existingSkipped`; eligible failure fails overall; read-only workspace failure, never skip.
- `expectedRevision: null` rejects post-selection concurrent creation.
- Composition: class explicit deps; `InitializePersistedSpecStateDeps`, `resolveInitializePersistedSpecStateDeps(resolver: CompositionResolver)`, canonical deps and config `createInitializePersistedSpecState`; config uses one resolver then canonical factory. Resolver has workspace repos, `ListWorkspaces`, `GetActiveSchema`, shared dependency resolver.
- Export use case/types/deps/factory Core public surface, SDK; `Kernel.specs.initializePersistedState`.
## Constraints
- Only existing artifacts; never create artifacts.
- Same `resolveInitialPersistedDependsOn()` used initialization, incidental first-lock mutations, `ArchiveChange`; no local copy.
- Never legacy fallback `{ schema: { name: `unknown`, version: 0 } }`.
